381ca5a3a343.title: Design Intern
381ca5a3a343.description_html:
About OnePay

OnePay is the consumer fintech trusted by millions of Americans to make money better.

Our financial system is broken. High fees, low rates, and too few ways to actually grow your money. We’re fixing it. And we’re moving fast.

We’re an all-in-one financial services platform that brings together banking, high-yield savings, credit cards, point-of-sale lending, investing, and crypto in one place. We also partner with employers, HCM providers, gig platforms, and others to deliver embedded financial services to millions of employees and frontline workers.

We’re backed by Walmart, the world’s largest retailer, and Ribbit Capital, one of fintech’s most respected investors, giving us rare scale, distribution, and the opportunity to build something truly category-defining.

But what really sets OnePay apart is how we move. Our customers don’t have time to wait… and neither do we. This place moves fast, and we’re looking for people who are:

  • Ready to run

  • Hungry and driven by urgency

  • Exceptional at what they do, with low ego

  • Comfortable operating in motion

The Role

As a Design Intern at OnePay, you’ll work alongside the Design team to support product discovery, competitive analysis, interaction design, prototyping, and design systems work across active initiatives. You’ll gain hands-on exposure to how a fast-moving fintech builds and scales product design.

  • Team Integration: You’ll be paired with Design team members and work alongside Product and Engineering partners, with opportunities to collaborate with Analytics. You’ll participate in design reviews, critiques, product discovery, and competitive analysis.

  • Real-World Projects: You’ll support product discovery, competitive analysis, interaction design, and prototyping, and contribute to our design system while working on real product surfaces from concept through execution.

  • Skill Building & Career Growth: Throughout the internship, you’ll attend workshops focused on technical skills, resume building, interview prep, and professional development. You’ll also have the chance to engage with company leadership during networking events.

  • Mentorship: Receive guidance and feedback from your manager, as well as a dedicated mentor who will help you navigate your internship experience, ensuring continuous learning and growth.

You Bring

  • In Your Final Year of Undergrad: You’re a current Bachelor’s student expected to graduate in Fall 2027 or Spring 2028, majoring in Design, HCI, Interaction Design, Visual Design, or a related field.

  • Prior Experience: You’ve completed at least one previous internship, or have built a portfolio of substantial personal or academic design projects you’re excited to talk through.

  • Availability: This is a full-time, 8-week program running June 21 - August 13, 2027. You are available to work in our New York City office at least 3-4 days a week throughout the entire program.

  • Proactive & Collaborative Attitude: You have an act-like-an-owner mentality, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and enjoy working with others to achieve collective goals.

  • Critical Thinking & Problem-Solving Skills: You enjoy tackling complex challenges, analyzing problems, and developing solutions. Clear communication of ideas is one of your strengths.

  • Organized & Detail-Oriented: You’re a keen listener with strong organizational skills, capable of managing multiple tasks efficiently.

  • Excited to Learn & Grow: You are passionate about being part of a rapidly growing organization and look forward to expanding your skills in a real-world setting.

What We Offer

  • Early access to a high potential, high growth fintech

  • Hands on experience

  • Beautiful NYC SoHo Office

  • Professional development and team social outings

Program & Application Timeline

  • Program runs June 21 - August 13, 2027 (8 weeks, full-time, in our NYC office)

  • We review applications and conduct interviews on a rolling basis as they come in

  • No offer decisions will be made until the application window closes – all candidates are evaluated together before final decisions go out

  • We are targeting a finalized cohort by December 1, 2026

  • If there are intern spots still available, we may reopen applications in Spring 2027

Work Authorization: OnePay will not sponsor applicants who need employment sponsored visas for this position. Future sponsorship will not be considered.

Standard Interview Process

Our process varies by role. Most candidates go through:

  • AI-assisted initial screen

  • Interview with Talent Partner

  • Technical or Hiring Manager Interview

  • Team Interview

  • Executive Interview

  • Offer!

Equal Employment Opportunity

To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us at talent@onepay.com.

38fe5c221b65.title: Software Engineer (New Grad)
38fe5c221b65.description_html:
About Strada

Strada is building the operating layer for AI-driven insurance.

Our platform deploys expert AI agents across calls, texts, emails, and chat - running core front-office workflows from policy servicing to claims intake. With a singular focus on insurance, Strada offers domain expertise and product depth that generic AI platforms can't match.

Backed by Y Combinator and top-tier investors, Strada already automates more than 1M customer interactions for leading insurers, MGAs, and brokers representing $20B+ in annual premiums. Adoption is accelerating across the industry.

Insurance is one of the largest and most complex industries in the world, and modern AI has the potential to fundamentally reshape how it operates. Strada is replacing fragmented workflows with AI-native infrastructure that runs real operations at scale - at the intersection of AI, infrastructure, and highly regulated real-world systems.

We're a small, high-ownership team based in San Francisco, already embedded in production systems at sophisticated insurance organizations. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and shape the future of a massive industry, let's meet.

Why Insurance?

Insurance quietly powers the global economy - it helps businesses stay open, families recover from disasters, and entire industries manage risk. But the way insurance operates hasn't changed in decades. Many frontline workflows still rely on phone calls and legacy systems.

We're building AI that plugs into those workflows and makes them radically faster, smarter, and more efficient. It's a $300B+ market ripe for innovation.

The Role

We're looking for a Software Engineer to join as one of our earliest engineering hires. You'll work across the stack to build the core systems that power our AI agents – from real-time voice infrastructure to integrations with insurance platforms.

This is a high-impact role where you'll ship production code from day one, learn fast, and grow alongside the company.

What you'll get done in the first week

  • Ship your first PR to production (on the first day) - no months of onboarding, you're contributing from day one

  • Get hands-on with our voice AI stack and understand how we're automating thousands of insurance calls daily

  • Meet the team, shadow customer calls, and see exactly how your code impacts real users

What you'll do in your first 30 days

  • Own a feature end-to-end - from scoping to shipping - that directly improves how our AI agents handle customer conversations

  • Optimize live systems handling real insurance workflows for major carriers

  • Start building intuition for the insurance domain and understand why this $1T+ industry is ripe for AI

What you'll do in your first 90 days

  • Take ownership of a core product area and drive meaningful improvements independently

  • Contribute to launches that land in front of customers - not internal tools that sit on a shelf

  • Have a real seat at the table on product and technical decisions as employee #10 at a company that just went from $0 to $1M ARR in 9 months

What You'll Need

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field

  • Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and system design

  • Experience building software in internships, coursework, or personal projects

  • Comfort working across the stack – we use TypeScript, React, and Node.js

  • Thrive in fast-moving, high-ownership environments

Nice to Have

  • Experience with real-time systems, WebSockets, or telephony

  • Familiarity with AI/LLM-based platforms or prompt engineering

  • Prior experience at an early-stage startup

  • Contributions to open source projects

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary ($110K–$140K) & meaningful equity

  • Employee-friendly equity terms

  • Macbook Pro, 4K display and all the accessories

  • Health, dental & vision insurance

  • Regular team events & offsites

  • Daily team dinners provided (Mon–Fri)

  • Gym membership

**IMPORTANT NOTE: This position is on-site at our San Francisco
